provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled coexistence curve with ideal vapor and negligible condensed molar volume: d ln(P_sat)/dT=DeltaH(T)/(R*T^2). Heat-capacity difference is constant, so DeltaH(T)=H_ref+DeltaCp*(T-T_ref). H_ref and DeltaCp are unknown. The integrated relation is ln(P/P_ref)=H_ref/R*(1/T_ref-1/T)+DeltaCp/R*(ln(T/T_ref)+T_ref/T-1).
analysis_policy: Estimate the two unknown thermodynamic parameters using ONLY the two nonreference calibration observations and their common reference point. Predict the held-out pressure without using it to fit. For the constant-enthalpy shortcut retain the inferred H_ref but set DeltaCp=0. Relative error=(shortcut_pressure-prediction)/prediction.
scope: Stipulated finite-window thermodynamics of a hypothetical benign phase pair, not new experimental vapor pressures or a global phase diagram.
